Faster Decisions. "More potential is wasted in action than in incompetence"
Prioritize Health. You have ten different problems until you have a health problem.
Buy a good macbook. Makes your life faster.
Be an autodidact. Any great learner is a self-learner. Even the best teacher can't help you unless you are willing to help yourself.
Don't say "no" to convos during the rain. An evening chat with any soul carrying a curious mind is always interesting.
Sleep at 10pm; Wake up at 6am. No comments on this one.
Write Morning Pages. Control your thoughts to control your life.
Open a Twitter account. It is our age's House of Wisdom.
Buy an Audible subscription. You will start finishing 10 times faster.
Use notebook to-do lists. When you can see the tasks in real life, it is usually better.
Invest in a great chair. Protect your spine.
Say "thank you" more often. Be grateful to people who deserve it.
Track your expenses monthly. Control your money, or it will control you.
Say "I don't know" without apologizing. No one is knowledgeable in everything. Be "vulnerable" to know more.
Learn to touch type properly. If you can't write 60 words per minute, you are done.
Carry a water bottle with you. Dehydration causes headaches.
Delete one social media app ruthlessly. The one that takes your most time.
Invest in a physical library. Visualize your knowledge.
